name: Remove text formatting
note: Turn pasted text, UTF-8/UTF-16 text files, HTML, Markdown or Word DOCX body text into a UTF-8 TXT file locally. Removes styles, links and markup while retaining readable text and basic paragraph/table breaks. Plain text preserves literal punctuation. No OCR; DOCX headers, footers, images and comments are omitted. Up to 8 MiB per input.
